text:
If tonight's on your porch list, this is the one to take, clear skies settling in with the sun already down and temps easing toward the low 60s by morning. Winds are going light and variable on the lake, so if you're still out there it'll lay down glassy calm, just watch that water's still a steamy 77.

Wednesday's the flip side. Sunny to start, high near 81 again, but the forecasters have been dialing up shower and thunderstorm chances through the afternoon as a system works in, call it 40 percent with a stray rumble possible. The American model's a bit more bullish on rain than the European or Canadian guidance, so there's real spread on how wet it actually gets, but I'd keep the umbrella within reach past midday just in case. Air quality's a non-issue, good and clean. Good, calm window for the water tonight and into tomorrow morning; by early afternoon Wednesday I'd have half an eye on the sky if you're planning to be out on the lake.
